predictions.question: My engineering degree is related to a Green List role but I am unsure whether my qualification meets the listed requirement. What qualification evidence does INZ use?
predictions.answer:
For Green List evidence, INZ says an applicant can provide the qualification itself. If the Green List requirement is for a New Zealand qualification and the qualification was gained outside New Zealand, INZ can also require an International Qualification Assessment (IQA) from NZQA.

The Manual says an IQA assesses an overseas qualification by stating the learning outcomes of the closest New Zealand equivalent qualification, the NZQF level and qualification type of that equivalent, and any verification NZQA undertook. For qualification points claims, the applicant must provide the qualification certificate, and if the qualification is from outside New Zealand, either an IQA from NZQA or the qualification must be on the List of Qualifications Exempt from Assessment.

So, the qualification evidence INZ uses is the qualification certificate, and for overseas qualifications in some cases an IQA from NZQA.
